email.automated: This is an automated message from PeopleForge, the Sirius Group HR portal. Please don't reply to it.

body.one: Your increment request {reference} with {count} employee was submitted to Sirius HR. Sirius HR reviews it criterion by criterion; you'll be told when they respond.
body.other: Your increment request {reference} with {count} employees was submitted to Sirius HR. Sirius HR reviews it criterion by criterion; you'll be told when they respond.

body.one: {actor} submitted increment request {reference} from {entity} with {count} employee. It is waiting for your review.
body.other: {actor} submitted increment request {reference} from {entity} with {count} employees. It is waiting for your review.

stage_changed.subject: {reference}: criterion {criterion} of {of} under review
stage_changed.body: Sirius HR verified the earlier criteria of increment request {reference} for every employee. Criterion {criterion} of {of} is now under review.

employee_approved.subject: {employee} approved in {reference}
employee_approved.body: Sirius HR approved the increment for {employee} in request {reference}. Open the request to see the approved figures.

employee_rejected.subject: {employee} rejected in {reference}
employee_rejected.body: Sirius HR rejected the increment for {employee} in request {reference}. Open the request to see the reason.

employee_returned.subject: Action needed: {employee} returned in {reference}
employee_returned.body: Sirius HR returned {employee} in request {reference} with a question. Update the employee and resubmit.

body.one: Sirius HR approved the remaining {count} employee in increment request {reference} at the proposed increment. Open the request to see the figures.
body.other: Sirius HR approved the remaining {count} employees in increment request {reference} at the proposed increments. Open the request to see the figures.

body.one: Sirius HR rejected the remaining {count} employee in increment request {reference}. Open the request to see the reason.
body.other: Sirius HR rejected the remaining {count} employees in increment request {reference}. Open the request to see the reason.

employees_returned.subject: Action needed: remaining employees returned in {reference} ({count})

body.one: Sirius HR returned the remaining {count} employee in increment request {reference} with a question. Update and resubmit.
body.other: Sirius HR returned the remaining {count} employees in increment request {reference} with a question. Update and resubmit.

request_decided.subject: {reference} decided: {status}
request_decided.body: Sirius HR decided every employee in increment request {reference}. Final status: {status}.

body.one: {actor} resubmitted increment request {reference} from {entity} with {count} returned employee. It is waiting for your review.
body.other: {actor} resubmitted increment request {reference} from {entity} with {count} returned employees. It is waiting for your review.

question_asked.subject: Question from Sirius HR about {employee} ({reference})
question_asked.body: Sirius HR asked a question about {employee} in increment request {reference}. Open the employee in PeopleForge to answer.

question_answered.subject: {entity} answered about {employee} ({reference})
question_answered.body: {actor} from {entity} answered your question about {employee} in increment request {reference}.

review_overdue.subject: Reminder: {reference} from {entity} is waiting for review

body.one: {count} employee in increment request {reference} from {entity} has waited more than {days} days for Sirius HR's review.
body.other: {count} employees in increment request {reference} from {entity} have waited more than {days} days for Sirius HR's review.

return_overdue.subject: Reminder: {reference} is waiting for your update

body.one: Sirius HR returned {count} employee in increment request {reference} more than {days} days ago. Update the employee and resubmit.
body.other: Sirius HR returned {count} employees in increment request {reference} more than {days} days ago. Update them and resubmit.

body.one: Your draft increment request {reference} with {count} employee isn't submitted yet. The submission deadline is {deadline}.
body.other: Your draft increment request {reference} with {count} employees isn't submitted yet. The submission deadline is {deadline}.

body.one: {actor} uploaded {entity}'s employee data for {period}. Version {version} is now in use, with {flags} anomaly flag to review.
body.other: {actor} uploaded {entity}'s employee data for {period}. Version {version} is now in use, with {flags} anomaly flags to review.

group_flags_raised.subject: Action needed: {count} anomaly flags on {entity} {period} data

body.one: Your upload {reference} of {entity}'s employee data for {period} was accepted and raised {count} anomaly flag. You own it: confirm or correct the value and resolve it with a note.
body.other: Your upload {reference} of {entity}'s employee data for {period} was accepted and raised {count} anomaly flags. You own them: confirm or correct each value and resolve it with a note.

flag_updated.subject: Anomaly flag {flag} ({entity}): {flagStatus}
flag_updated.body: {actor} updated anomaly flag {flag} for {entity}. It is now {flagStatus}; you are its owner.

flag_reminder.subject: Reminder: anomaly flag {flag} ({entity}) is waiting for you
flag_reminder.body: {actor} from Sirius HR sent a reminder about anomaly flag {flag} for {entity}. Please review it and resolve it with a note.

upload_due.subject: Reminder: {entity} employee data for {period} not uploaded
upload_due.body: {entity}'s employee data for {period} hasn't been uploaded yet, {days} days after the month ended. Please upload it to PeopleForge.

flag_open.subject: Reminder: anomaly flag {flag} ({entity}) open for {days} days
flag_open.body: Anomaly flag {flag} for {entity} has been open for more than {days} days. You are its owner: please review it and resolve it with a note.
